map.每行首个字段为资料文本，其后逗号分隔的为主题标签；统计各主题出现频次，覆盖率 =: The first field of each row is the material text, followed by comma-separated theme tags; count each theme frequency, coverage = coded entries ÷ total entries, stability judged by appearing ≥3 times.
map.饱和度提示：当连续若干条（默认5）均未出现新主题时，提示可停止抽样。本工具仅做频: Saturation hint: when several consecutive entries (default 5) show no new theme, it hints sampling can stop. This tool only does frequency and coverage statistics; theme distillation still requires the researcher to judge with context.
